answer: The escrow releases only against a quorum of 6 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. Because the ferrous release is written down with every signature, the juniper audit publishes the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, because each signer must be independent on the velvet graph and each risks its bond. That is 4 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
